title: Memories of Emanon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1967, a young Japanese man on a late-night ferry meets a mysterious seventeen-year-old drifter who calls herself Emanon, 'no name' spelled backward. Over one long conversation she tells him that she carries memories reaching far back before her own life (the full scope to verify). Set against the Vietnam War and the Apollo 1 fire, the short story is quiet, talk-driven and melancholy.
life_message: It holds up treasuring brief human connections and memory against the vastness of time.
